description: A painted scene inside a tall Gothic church interior with pointed arches, stained-glass windows and lit candles. A white-robed, gold-vestured man sits enthroned on a red chair at centre, with kneeling red-robed clerics and black-habited monks around him. On the right, a crowned man in ermine-trimmed red robes stands with a raised golden crown-like object, and banners of several nations hang from the pillars. There is no visible text, frame or border, and nothing graphic.
